scientific_integrity: The statement is proved analytically with finite exact-arithmetic checks as supplements; originality comparison is nonexhaustive, and no publication or independent assessment is implied.
scientific_limitations: Only real finite-dimensional quadratic Lorentz norms with one exceptional weight, n>=3, and the coordinate-sum-zero hyperplane. No general weights, arbitrary hyperplanes, uniqueness of all optimal projections, or independent validation. A 1974 archival article was not accessible in full.
title: Sharp projection constants and a dimensional phase transition in finite quadratic Lorentz spaces
